name: Luma slime
doc: Slime-mould agents whose food is the picture's brightness: they smell trail plus light, linger and respawn on bright places, and weave a web of veins that redraws the image, each vein in the picture's own colour over a dim copy of it. Mids widen the sensor angle, bass stretches its reach, loudness speeds the agents and thickens the deposit; each onset blooms a burst of agents across the light near a seeded spot and flashes the veins.

in.doc: the picture: vein colours and the dim backdrop (core-media.out)

luma.doc: the food map (core-media.luma); without it, the luma of in

palette.doc: colours the veins over grey or black parts of the picture; the top stop flares the densest veins

cells.doc: trail map height in cells (width follows the aspect)

angle.doc: sensor angle in degrees (mids widen it)

reach.doc: sensor distance in cells at 540 (bass stretches it)

speed.doc: cells per step at 540 (loudness speeds it)

food.doc: how strongly the light attracts, against the trail

linger.doc: slow-down on bright places (they gather there)

respawn.doc: percent of agents per step that respawn on a bright spot

burst.doc: share of agents an onset respawns

bg.doc: brightness of the picture under the veins

saturation.doc: 1 = veins in the picture's hue, 0 = in the palette
